criteria.criterion_scope: Proxy bound applies to active proxy handlers; native semaphore/middleware bounds apply through actual handler return. Remote observer peaks are reported, not incorrectly constrained by proxy admission. No throughput-win gate.

methodology.traffic: Sorted independent uniform arrival times, conditional on exact request count; service and priority shuffled independently. Exactly matched per-phase seed and plan digest across policies. Fresh UUIDs for isolated writes excluded from plan identity. Service mix60/20/20,80%critical except background-flood20%; no retries.100ms useful budget includes scheduling, HTTP, queue and execution. SQLtimeout1s; client3s except deliberate20ms deadline.
methodology.configuration: Ceiling4 and SQL pool4 per service. Stable adaptive starts4/floor2; reservation1. Fixed reservations0,1,2,3 and per-service orders2/catalog1/inventory1 are predeclared. Other Gatewise policies disabled; proxy adds fourth application process/hop.
methodology.selection: Criteria and all17cases frozen before confirmatory matrix. Exploratory pilot is excluded; no win gate. Seeds101/202/303 are matched across all cases; rotated case order.

aggregation: Three paired seeds. Throughput and p95 are medians of run-level values; ranges show seed min/max, not confidence intervals. Refusal/error/deadline percentages pool counts. Service-filtered SQL wait uses that service's real counters, shared by both priorities. Every policy/seed/phase must have the same plan SHA256. Conditional-Poisson arrival times preserve exact offered count; independently shuffled service/priority totals remove periodic ordering. Per-service input ratios can vary between seeds. No win gate or post-hoc scope reclassification.
overhead: Same successful empty-body sequential no-op benchmark, five runs per mode before and after on the same host/toolchain. Before uses preserved v0.11.0 source snapshot; after uses v0.11.1. Observer present in all modes. No network/SQL/contended queue waiting; allocated bytes are not retained heap or process RSS. Timing is host-specific. Public decision/context/snapshot views remain detached; no object pooling or lifetime shortening.
scope: Middleware holds executing handler permits through return. Proxy limits active proxy handlers; remote cleanup can outlive those requests. Controlled cancellation probe validates that distinction with actual PostgreSQL; no claim that arbitrary remote work can be forcibly stopped. Image built/tested natively with Podman; versioned GHCR image is linux/amd64.
